text: When several services become slow with flat resource KPIs, compare parent-child start gaps and operation latency across the candidate neighborhood. Seek proxy errors and unaffected peers before choosing a network failure subtype. This is an investigation pattern, not a labeled incident.

When both a node and a pod are anomalous, check whether sibling pods on the node share the onset. A shared onset can motivate a node-level hypothesis, but correlated symptoms alone are insufficient. This card contains no benchmark answers.
